title: touch
snippet:
#### OPTIONS [...] >
> -r ref\_file
> :   Use the corresponding time of the file named by the pathname ref\_file instead of the current time.
>
> -t time
> :   Use the specified time instead of the current time. The option-argument shall be a decimal number of the form:
>
>     ```
>     [[CC]YY]MMDDhhmm[.SS] 
>     ```
>
>     where each two digits represents the following:
>
>     MM
>     :   The month of the year [01,12].
>
>     DD
>     :   The day of the month [01,31].
>
>     hh [...] #### EXAMPLES
